title: Grateful Dead Live at McArthur Court, University of Oregon on 1969-05-31

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a fiery May‑69 Oregon show, featuring an epic extended “He Was A Friend Of Mine”, soaring “Baby Blue” and a monster Dark Star.
ai_review.review: The recording is a solid soundboard source that, while not pristine, delivers clear enough audio to let the band’s high‑energy performance shine. Reviewers rave about the extended “He Was A Friend Of Mine”, the emotive “Baby Blue”, a powerful Dark Star and tight transitions into The Other One/​Cryptical, making this one of the standout 1969 tapes. Minor technical hiccups (a cut on “Doin’ That Rag” and occasional roughness) don’t detract from an overall superb show.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 30 reviews overwhelmingly rate the show 4‑5 stars, praising performance and only noting modest recording flaws; strong consensus yields a high confidence rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear soundboard mix; some reviewers note it isn’t perfect and mention a cut on “Doin’ That Rag” and occasional muddiness, but overall listenable.

standout_songs: He Was A Friend Of Mine
show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers highlight smooth segues—especially The Other One into Cryptical—and a balanced mix of ballads, jams and high‑octane rock that keeps the momentum high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for his guitar tone on “He Was A Friend Of Mine” and emotive playing on “Baby Blue”; noted as “on fire”.
band_member_comments.Bob: Green Grass (Weir’s ballad) singled out as a great moment; vocals mentioned positively in several reviews.
